form.name: Device name
form.doorOpenHint: Leave blank to inherit the global lock pulse.
form.keyNotice: On save, the system generates the device secret key. The firmware uses it to authenticate, and it is never stored in plain text.

secret.title: Copy it now — there is no second chance
secret.body: Once you leave this screen the key cannot be shown again. If lost, rotate the key from the device detail.
secret.pathHint: Paste into secrets.h and reflash hardware.ino.
secret.confirm: I confirm I copied the key and stored it safely.

rotate.confirmTitle: Rotating invalidates the current key immediately
rotate.confirmBody: The device in the field will get 401 until secrets.h is rewritten with the new key. Rotating does not re-enable a disabled device.
